devil_wears_prada.title: The Devil Wears Prada
devil_wears_prada.description: A fresh college grad lands a job as an assistant to Miranda Priestly, the ruthless editor of a top fashion magazine. Thrown into a world of glam and chaos, she must choose between her dream job and her personal life.

lala_land.title: La La Land
lala_land.description: A jazz musician and an aspiring actress fall in love while chasing their dreams in Los Angeles. As their careers take off, they must decide if ambition is worth the cost of love and what truly makes life meaningful.

interstellar.title: Interstellar
interstellar.description: With Earth facing extinction, a group of explorers travel through a wormhole in search of a new home for humanity. As time bends and space unravels, the mission becomes a race against time and emotional gravity.

mean_girls.title: Mean Girls
mean_girls.description: Cady Heron, raised in Africa by scientist parents, enters public school for the first time and gets sucked into a social minefield ruled by the popular Plastics. A satirical and iconic look at teen cliques, identity, and girl world drama.

stranger_things.title: Stranger Things
stranger_things.description: Set in the '80s, a young boy vanishes from a small town, leading his friends and family into a world of secret experiments, telekinetic powers, and creepy creatures from an alternate dimension called the Upside Down.

h2o.title: H2O: Just Add Water
h2o.description: After a mysterious encounter with a magical island cave, three teenage girls gain mermaid powers. Now, every splash risks exposing their secret while navigating school, friendship, and first crushes.

friends.title: Friends
friends.description: Six inseparable friends — Monica, Ross, Rachel, Chandler, Joey, and Phoebe — navigate the hilarious highs and lows of life, love, and work in New York City. A heartwarming and iconic sitcom that shaped a generation.

adventure_time.title: Adventure Time
adventure_time.description: In the Land of Ooo, Finn the Human and Jake the Dog embark on wild, colorful adventures, fighting evil, making friends, and learning the weirdness of growing up — with swords, songs, and lots of surreal fun.
